info.name: Ouvira ERP — QA Test Suite
info.description:
Production-grade QA automation suite.
Covers: functional, edge, security, boundary, and data-integrity tests.

## How to run
1. Import this collection + Ouvira_QA.postman_environment.json
2. Single run: Postman Runner → select collection → select environment
3. Data-driven: Postman Runner → select CSV/JSON from test_data/ folder
4. CI: newman run Ouvira_QA_Suite.postman_collection.json -e Ouvira_QA.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit

## Folder structure
- 🔐 Auth Tests
- 👤 Account Tests
- 🏢 Company Tests
- 🔑 Access Control Tests
- 👥 HRIS Core Tests
- 📋 Recruitment Tests
- 🛡️ Security Tests (cross-cutting)
- ⚡ Performance Hints
